Description: D-051: owner-approved PUA, configured cloud protection, reported tamper protection and standard ASR vulnerable driver blocking. Composed with each exact Windows 11 profile. Other ASR rules remain inventory-only. No native validation or effective enforcement claim.

Criteria.Name: Potentially unwanted application blocking configured

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner explicit scoring approval D-051; Microsoft technical reference reviewed

Criteria.Interpretation: BLOCK is the proposed target. AUDIT records activity without blocking. Unknown telemetry is not FAIL. Microsoft recommends assessing audit results before deployment; browser download protection is separate.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review organizational policy and PUA audit results, then have an authorized administrator consider blocking. Confirm the resulting setting with a new read-only scan.

Criteria.Name: Cloud protection configured

Source.Title: Configure cloud protection in Microsoft Defender Antivirus

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner explicit scoring approval D-051; Microsoft technical reference reviewed

Criteria.Interpretation: Assesses configuration only: Basic or Advanced maps to ENABLED; absent or unrecognized telemetry is UNKNOWN, not FAIL. Does not test connectivity, samples or effective cloud blocking.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review the approved cloud protection and privacy policies, service connectivity and management authority before an authorized administrator changes settings. Sample submission is a separate decision.

Criteria.Name: Tamper protection reported enabled

Source.Title: Protect security settings with tamper protection

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner explicit scoring approval D-051; Microsoft technical reference reviewed

Criteria.Interpretation: Assesses only an observed Boolean IsTamperProtected state on the exact Windows 11 profile with Defender in Normal mode. Unavailable or unrecognized telemetry is UNKNOWN, not FAIL; management authority and effectiveness are not claimed.
Criteria.Recommendation: Verify support, active antivirus mode, authorized management and any troubleshooting exception before an authorized administrator restores the approved tamper protection configuration.

Criteria.Name: ASR: vulnerable signed driver blocking configured

Source.Title: Microsoft ASR standard protection: block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers

Verification.ReviewedBy: Project owner explicit scoring approval D-051; Microsoft technical reference reviewed

Criteria.Interpretation: Scores only required rule 56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5. BLOCK passes; AUDIT, WARN, DISABLED or NOT_CONFIGURED fail this local policy. Missing rule is NOT_CONFIGURED only in a complete coherent inventory. Unavailable or incomplete inventory is UNKNOWN. Does not test existing driver loading, other ASR rules, LSA or WMI exceptions.
Criteria.Recommendation: Review the approved local baseline and application compatibility, then have the authorized administrator configure this specific ASR rule in Block mode. Re-scan read-only. Do not bulk-enable other ASR rules; LSASS and WMI rules require their own applicability review.
